arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Spivey argued the Court should reaffirm the existing precedent entirely.
She stated that advice is a factor particularly worth noting.
Mr. Thompson argued that police questioning is a legitimate technique.
He noted that the record did not indicate the bus was delayed.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of the Fourth Amendment during routine bus stops. It asks if police must inform passengers they can say no to a search request.

The defense wants the Court to require officers to state that passengers may refuse.
